speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: The light went off the loom. I am in. I said I would not knock, and this is not a knock. It is the foot of the stair, and I am already home.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then there is no news in it. The page is folded. I am out when it is full dark.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: There is no plate for you at six, sir. I am saying it on the stair so the stair does not have to carry it up.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I do not ask what is in the fold. Feet this morning were enough for a ceiling.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep them as feet. I am not sending you out, and I am not sending her.
